Bug_Title: SA: Self assignment of local rather than assignment to field (SA_LOCAL_SELF_ASSIGNMENT_INSTEAD_OF_FIELD)
Bug_Explanation: The method setFoo contains a self-assignment of the local variable 'foo', which is intended to assign the value to the instance field 'foo'. This renders the assignment useless.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case 'testShowBug' calls the method 'showBug' with a value of 10. This triggers the bug because 'setFoo' method performs a self-assignment of the local variable 'foo' instead of assigning it to the instance variable 'foo'. As a result, the instance variable 'foo' remains uninitialized (default value 0), causing the assertEquals to fail.
